defActiveText: Unique members who earned or redeemed points in the selected period. Reversals, expiry and cancellation refunds are excluded. Participation divides this count by members who had joined by the period end. Weekly counts are not added together.
defSalesText: New members use their recorded join date. Sales are paid member-linked stays and appointments booked in the period, net of refunds, in the venue currency. They are not measured loyalty uplift. Test bookings and other currencies are excluded.
defPointsText: Issued, redeemed and expired are period movements. Reversed lines do not count; legacy cancellation refunds reduce redeemed points. Outstanding points are active members’ current balances, not a historical balance.
defClaimsText: Claims are reward redemptions created in the selected period. Fulfilment is the number currently fulfilled divided by all period claims, including cancellations. Benefit approvals are separate and do not count as reward fulfilment.
defCohortsText: Each cohort contains members who joined in that seven-day bucket. Returns count distinct members with qualifying activity in each later full week. Weeks after the report end are not observed. Inactivity uses active members’ last recorded activity, excluding members never active.
defScopeText: Comparison uses the immediately preceding period of equal length. Counts use relative percent change; rates use percentage points. Both periods use current member records and current level filters, across all places. Level distribution, balances and future expiry are snapshots now; claim statuses are also current.
